trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Another one! First the old man, then the kid with the hat, and now you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Go on, then. The Commander will sort you out.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: This lake belongs to Team Galactic today. Turn round and go home!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: It's still ours. You just... walked through it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Shh! The Commander is working. Nobody disturbs the Commander!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Well, that's her disturbed. I'm for it now.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Your friend didn't get past the Commander, and you won't get past me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: All right, you got past me. That was the easy part.
